_description: POST /api/agents/prompt — Creates a prompt agent with an OpenAPI tool backed by any REST API registered as a Foundry connection.
_notes: name is a short identifier for the tool function (used by the model).
spec must be a valid OpenAPI 3.x document serialised as a JSON string. Only expose the operations you want the agent to call.
authType values: Connection (default, requires connectionName), Managed (requires audience), Anonymous.
connectionName must match a connection from GET /api/connections when authType is Connection.
The example spec below exposes two GET endpoints for listing and reading blobs in Azure Blob Storage.
instructions: You can list and read blobs from Azure Storage. Use the BlobStorageApi tool to retrieve file contents when the user asks about stored documents.
description: Agent that reads Azure Blob Storage via an OpenAPI tool.

tools.name: BlobStorageApi
tools.spec: {"openapi":"3.0.0","info":{"title":"Blob Storage API","version":"1.0.0"},"paths":{"/containers/{container}/blobs":{"get":{"operationId":"listBlobs","summary":"List blobs in a container","parameters":[{"name":"container","in":"path","required":true,"schema":{"type":"string"}}],"responses":{"200":{"description":"List of blob names","content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}}}}}}}},"/containers/{container}/blobs/{blobName}":{"get":{"operationId":"readBlob","summary":"Read the contents of a blob","parameters":[{"name":"container","in":"path","required":true,"schema":{"type":"string"}},{"name":"blobName","in":"path","required":true,"schema":{"type":"string"}}],"responses":{"200":{"description":"Blob content as text","content":{"text/plain":{"schema":{"type":"string"}}}}}}}}}}
